name: chainsage-monorepo
description: ChainSage monorepo root. Declares the npm workspace so the shared @chainsage/* packages (engine, policy-engine, trust-network) and the unified `site` app install from one root — hoisting shared deps like viem so the engine's TypeScript resolves them at build time.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @chainsage/engine && npm run test --workspace @chainsage/policy-engine && npm run test --workspace @chainsage/trust-network
